referees.quote: the current paper is not suitable for publication. ... We therefore recommend the authors to take major revisions according to the following points.

several aspects of the interpretation and presentation require some clarification and further justification ... I therefore recommend publication after the authors satisfactorily respond to the following questions and comments.
I co-reviewed this manuscript with one of the reviewers who provided the listed reports.

note: The manuscript was transferred from Nature Nanotechnology after two rounds of review there. R1 says so: 'previously reviewed in Nature Nanotechnology for two rounds and has been transferred'. The first round used here is Version 0 in this Nature Communications file. R1 calls the paper 'not suitable for publication' in its current form but explicitly recommends major revisions, so it is classed as major revision. R2 asks mainly for clarification and discussion rather than new data, and recommends publication once these points are addressed, so it is inferred as minor revision. R3 is an early-career co-reviewer and does not say which report they co-signed. They are assigned to R1, inferred from R1's plural voice ('We have compared', 'We therefore recommend'). This attribution is uncertain; if R3 co-signed R2's report, their recommendation would be minor revision.
